name: v1.3.0
body:
Sometimes these releases take time. Cherish it.

## 🛡️ What's Unmessed > [!caution] > > There was a small command injection risk in prior versions. I consider it very low because of the specifics of the action use case. But still, do upgrade, okay? > > @illera88[💰](https://github.com/sponsors/max-sixty) fixed this [template injection] bug in #37 by passing inputs via env vars. > > See GHSA-gj76-h2ch-5m76 for more detail that was first reported by @Corbynx010[💰](https://github.com/sponsors/Corbynx010) while I was at EuroPython. > > [template injection]: https://docs.zizmor.sh/audits/#template-injection ## ✨ What's Improved I did a bunch of internal refactoring including hints of what @max-sixty[💰](https://github.com/sponsors/max-sixty) reported in #23. And took a small patch of @krokofant[💰](https://github.com/sponsors/krokofant) in. This involved a bunch of preparatory infra work with testing infra. One notable improvement is that now thanks to @tomasr8[💰](https://github.com/sponsors/tomasr8)'s and @hugovk[💰](https://github.com/sponsors/hugovk)'s UX suggestions in #31, the gate status output is colored in the console and should be easier to scan in the log output per line. They entries now have leading `✓`/`❌` acceptance marks and the actual incoming job outcomes are labeled with `🟢`/`🔴`/`⬜`/`⚫`. ## 🐛 What's Fixed The job-statuses summary could print "Some of the allowed to be skipped jobs did not succeed" based on the wrong condition — it's now tied to `allowed-skips` as intended, not `allowed-failures`. ## 💪 New Contributors * @Corbynx010[💰](https://github.com/sponsors/Corbynx010) lurked in GHSA-gj76-h2ch-5m76 before everyone else :wink: * @illera88 made their first contribution in #37 and GHSA-gj76-h2ch-5m76 * @krokofant and @max-sixty first contributed in #23 * @tomasr8 and @hugovk in #31 **🪞 Full Diff**: https://github.com/re-actors/alls-green/compare/v1.2.2...v1.3.0 **🧔‍♂️ Release Manager:** [@webknjaz](https://github.com/sponsors/webknjaz) [🇺🇦](https://stand-with-ukraine.pp.ua) **💬 Discuss** [on Bluesky 🦋](https://bsky.app/profile/did:plc:ve6s3mxkefjaxty3m4fdqumn/post/3mtn27ckwcs2g), [on Mastodon 🐘](https://mastodon.social/@webknjaz/117136385624434132) and [on GitHub][release discussion].
